basic.name: Staggering Blow
basic.description: Swing your chain in a wide arc, dealing 140~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. If an enemy hits terrain, deal an additional 150~~0.04~~ damage, Stun for 0.75 seconds, and gain 15 Rage.

basic.name: Ez-Thro Dynamite
basic.description:
Toss a bundle of Dynamite with a 1.5 second fuse. Upon detonation, enemies take 180~~0.04~~ damage and are Slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. 

The Dynamite instantly detonates when landing on an enemy Hero granting Hogger 10 Rage.

basic.name: Hogg Wild
basic.description:
After 0.25 seconds, become Unstoppable and uncontrollably spin towards the target direction, ricocheting off terrain. Ricocheting off terrain refreshes the duration.

Every 0.125 seconds, deal 44~~0.04~~ damage to nearby non-Structure enemies. Damage against Heroes is increased by .5% for each point of Rage.

heroic.name: Hoardapult
heroic.description:
Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.

Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

heroic.name: Shockwave
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335~~0.04~~ damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230~~0.04~~ damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

trait.name: Loot Hoard
trait.description:
Toss a pile of junk onto the battlefield, dealing 102~~0.04~~ damage in an area, knocking enemies away, and acting as terrain for up to 5 seconds.

When the Loot Hoard expires or is destroyed, a chunk of Meat falls out that can be picked up to restore 3% of maximum Health every second for 4 seconds.

Reactivate to destroy Loot Hoard.

activable.name: On The Prowl
activable.description:
Activate to gain 25 Rage over 8 seconds.

Passive: You heal for 7~~0.04~~ Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.

activable.name: No Control
activable.description:
Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby.

Cannot be cancelled.

level1.name: Journeyman Cooking
level1.description:
Each Hero hit by Ez-Thro Dynamite heals you for 8% of maximum Health.

Quest: Hitting Heroes with Ez-Thro Dynamite permanently increases your maximum Health by 10, to a maximum of 750 bonus Health.

level1.name: Bones to Gnaw
level1.description: Loot Hoard creates a chunk of Meat when it lands. While under the effects of Meat, gain 10 Armor.

level1.name: On The Prowl
level1.description:
Activate to gain 25 Rage over 8 seconds.

Passive: You heal for 7~~0.04~~ Health every second, increased by 2% per point of Rage.

level4.name: Brute Force
level4.description:
Increase the range of Loot Hoard by 25% and its damage by 50%.

Quest: Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow permanently increases Basic Attack damage by 2, to a maximum of 150 bonus damage. Enemy Heroes that hit terrain grant an additional 6 damage.

level4.name: Aggro Range
level4.description: Increase Hogg Wild's radius by 20% and each enemy hit generates 0.5 Rage, increased to 2 against Heroes.

level4.name: Hogger's Joggers
level4.description:
While above 35Rage, gain 10% increased Movement Speed and healing received. 

When at or above 50 Rage, increase these bonuses to 15%.

level7.name: Dense Blasting Powder
level7.description:
Instant detonations of Ez-Thro Dynamite creates an additional dynamite behind the Hero hit.

Hitting the bundle of Ez-Thro Dynamite with Staggering Blow breaks it into three sticks and launches them forward in an arc.

level7.name: Garbage Fire
level7.description: Reduce the cooldown of Loot Hoard by 2 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds, enemies in a large area around Loot Hoard take 23~~0.04~~ damage and are Slowed by 20%.

level7.name: Seeing Red
level7.description: While above 50 Rage, gain 35% Attack Speed and the cooldowns of Staggering Blow and Hogg Wild refresh 30% faster.

level10.name: Hoardapult
level10.description:
Launch an empowered Loot Hoard with Hogger attached, dealing 100~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.

Hoardapult's Loot Hoard lasts for up to 20 seconds, decaying rapidly while not nearby. Every 10 seconds Hogger can take a chunk of Meat from the Loot Hoard.

level10.name: Shockwave
level10.description: After 0.5 seconds, slam the ground, sending out a shockwave that travels in a long line. Enemies hit by the initial slam take 335~~0.04~~ damage and are Stunned for 1.5 seconds. Enemies only hit by the shockwave take 230~~0.04~~ damage and are Stunned for 0.75 seconds.

level13.name: Dust Devil
level13.description: Gain 25 Armor while Hogg Wild is active and for 4 seconds after. When at or above 50 Rage, increase this Armor to 40.

level13.name: Pummel
level13.description:
Enemies hit by Hogg Wild are Slowed by 10% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. 

Heroes hit have their Spell Power reduced by 30% for 2 seconds.

level13.name: Bloodthirst
level13.description: Damaging Heroes with Basic Attacks, Staggering Blow, or Hogg Wild heals you for 33% of the damage dealt.

level16.name: Headbanger
level16.description: Enemy Heroes Stunned by Staggering Blow take an additional 8% of their maximum Health as damage and are Stunned for an additional 0.5 seconds.

level16.name: Kablooie!
level16.description:
Instant Ez-Thro Dynamite detonations deal 50% more damage, reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds, and increase its Slow amount to 50%. 

Passive: Increase Ez-Thro Dynamite's range by 25%.

level16.name: Furzerker
level16.description:
Hitting Heroes with Staggering Blow or Ez-Thro Dynamite increases the damage of the next Basic Attack within 8 seconds by 50%, stacking up to 2 times.

When Hogg Wild ends, gain 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

level20.name: Secret Stash
level20.description:
Every 2 seconds, Hoardapults' Loot Hoard randomly launches Ez-Thro Dynamite, prioritizing nearby enemy Heroes.

Every 5 seconds, it also launches a chunk of Meat towards Hogger.

level20.name: Power Spike
level20.description:
Hitting Heroes with Shockwave reduces their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds and grants 20 Rage.

Passive: Rage's cooldown reduction affects Shockwave's cooldown.

level20.name: No Control
level20.description:
Activate to cast an untalented Hogg Wild and begin chasing an enemy Hero. After reaching the Hero, bounce to a random nearby enemy Hero. Lasts up to 5 seconds, rapidly decaying if there are no other enemy Heroes nearby.

Cannot be cancelled.

level20.name: Anger Management
level20.description:
Increase maximum Rage by 50, raising the maximum bonuses for its cooldown refresh rate to 75% and Hogg Wild's Hero damage to 75%.

Passive: Basic Attacks grant 5 additional Rage.
